2.1 competitor pool analysis — seo sop express home station → journey → dabbo 02 🌐 → 2.1 🌐 2.1 — competitor pool analysis dabbo 02 · domain research & selection · ✅ done ☑️ mark done 📍 set current stop tamara top competitors juvo etle shortcut: te loko shu rank kare chhe, su lakhe chhe, kya thi backlinks le chhe - badhu free ma roadmap male. 2.1.a steps top 3-5 competitors shodho: main keyword google ma search karo - first page par je consistency sathe dekhay te j real competitors. temna top pages note karo: kaya pages sauthi vadhare traffic lave chhe (ubersuggest/semrush free trial). temna keywords juvo: kaya keywords par rank kare chhe je tamara pase nathi - te gap list chhe. content style juvo: ketlu lamba articles, images, videos, faq structure, schema. backlink sources note karo: kya sites temne link kare chhe - je relevant sites (directories, associations, pr, suppliers) tamne pan naturally link aapi shake te target list ma lo; paid/spam placements skip. 2.1.b pool mathi su levu je temna ma chhe pan tamara ma nathi (features, pages, topics) temni weakness (slow site, old content, no faq) - tya jeeto temna best content thi 10x better content banavvo 2.1.c checklist 3-5 competitors ni list + notes chhe keyword gap list banavi chhe temna 3 strengths ane 3 weaknesses lakhela chhe 2.1.d right competitors kevi rite shodhva (full sop, step-by-step) goal: selected target country mate organic search ma aapni sathe compete karta websites ni verified list banavvi. 5 methods: domain overview, keyword-based serp research, keyword gap, position tracking, ane manual google serp research. order: pehla method 1 thi base list (50 domains), pachhi method 2-5 thi nava domains, chhelle validate kari ne duplicates kadho. step 0: research taiyar karo aapnu exact domain lakho (original notes ma example: skylinestoneproducts.com). target country confirm karo — country-specific reports ma same country vapro. aapna main products, services ane business categories ni list banao. ek research spreadsheet taiyar karo — raw exports, keyword data, serp results ane final competitor list mate. raw research kyarey overwrite na karo. tab name shu store karvu domain overview export original csv export: domain, country, competitor metrics, traffic, keywords, cost. final competitors unique competitor domains, source method, target country, relevance, final status. keyword research keyword, volume, country volumes, kd, intent, cpc, trend, aapni position (available hoy to). serp results keyword, serp position, domain, ranking url, include/exclude decision, reason. method notes research date, database/country, filters, observations. method 1 — domain overview (base list) semrush → domain overview kholo. aapnu domain nakho (competitor nu nahi). initial overview mate country selector "worldwide" rakho (original workflow pramane) ane report run karo. "main organic competitors" card shodho → "view details" → "competitors" tab. have country selector ma target country select karo ane report refresh thava do — aa country badhi research ma consistent rakho. badha pages/results export karo (fakt pehla page nahi), csv format ma. original csv nu untouched copy "domain overview export" tab ma rakho. exported data par aa 5 filters ek ek kari ne apply karo ane darek ma strongest rows shortlist karo: top 10 com. level , top 10 common keywords , top 10 se keywords , top 10 traffic , top 10 costs . pachhi badha filters ni shortlists compare karo, duplicates kadho, ane total 50 competitors select karo — ae "final competitors" tab ma save karo. output: target country mate ~50 domains ni base competitor list. method 2 — keyword-based competitor research semrush → organic rankings kholo, aapnu domain nakho, "positions" tab kholo. "volume" column high → low sort karo. 500+ volume vala relevant keywords shortlist karo (aapna actual products/services sathe related j). darek "keyword research" tab ma note karo. darek shortlisted keyword click karo (ek ek kari ne) → keyword row ma preview icon click karo → popup ma "serp analysis" → top 10 serp results ma dekhata relevant business websites note karo. platform exclude karo: youtube, instagram, facebook, flipkart, amazon ane bija social/marketplace platforms — e business competitors nathi. fakt competing products/services aapta brand/business websites j include karo. eligible domains "final competitors" tab ma umero ane kayi keyword thi malya e note karo. darek keyword na popup metrics save karo: global volume, country-wise volumes, kd, sf, intent, cpc, trend. live report ma dekhata values j — example values copy nahi. metric original notes ma example shu note karvu global volume 10.6k keyword nu displayed global volume united states 9.9k popup ma dekhato country-specific volume australia 390 country-specific volume united kingdom 260 country-specific volume brazil 20 country-specific volume spain 20 country-specific volume kd possible (39%) kd label ane percentage sf +1 serp features value intent commercial keyword intent cpc $0.68 cpc value trend popup trend dekhay e trend record karo method 3 — keyword gap semrush → keyword gap kholo. first field ma aapnu website, baki fields ma known competitor domains (4 sudhi). target country/database select karo, organic keyword type select karo, "compare" click karo. tabs samjo: shared = common keywords; missing = competitors rank kare, aapne nahi; weak = aapne competitors karta niche; untapped = competitors rank kare, aapne bilkul nahi; strong = aapne vadhare saro; unique = fakt ek domain na. "missing" ane "untapped" reports thi chalu karo. aapna products/services sathe related ghana keywords par rank karta domains shodho. repeated ane meaningful overlap vala shortlist karo. darek shortlisted domain nu website kholo — products, services, target audience check karo. relevant business competitor hoy to "final competitors" ma umero. keyword gap report csv/excel ma export kari ne raw save karo. note karo: competitor domain, common/missing/untapped keywords, organic traffic, position, volume, kd (available hoy to). method 4 — position tracking competitor discovery semrush → position tracking ma project banao/select karo: aapnu domain, target country/location, device, ane important target keywords add karo. dashboard ma "competitors discovery" report kholo — aapna tracked keywords na google serps ma dekhata domains juo. ghana target keywords par repeated visibility vala domains shortlist karo. darek nu website kholi ne business relevance validate karo, pachhi "final competitors" ma umero, source = "position tracking". field shu capture karvu competitor domain competitors discovery ma dekhato domain common keywords e domain sathe shared relevant tracked keywords visibility % report ma dekhato visibility percentage estimated traffic estimated traffic (available hoy to) keyword positions relevant ranking positions target country position tracking ma configured country/location method 5 — manual google serp research aapna main products/services mathi keywords banao — high-volume ane commercial-intent ne priority. target country pramane list taiyar karo. original notes na examples: best stone countertops; quartz countertops near me; natural stone suppliers; best granite suppliers; quartzite countertops. darek keyword google ma search karo (relevant target-country context ma). top 10 organic results na domains note karo. ghana keywords par repeatedly dekhata websites mark karo. darek website kholi ne products, services ane target audience verify karo. ads, social profiles, marketplaces ke irrelevant directories ne direct business competitors na gano. save karo: search keyword, volume (available hoy to), google organic position, competitor domain, ranking url, target country, business relevance (high/medium/low). source = "manual google serp". final selection rules tool mathi avelo domain = fakt potential competitor. final list ma umerata pehla validate karo. domain target country ane aapni industry sathe relevant hovo joie; "questions" filter lagao - loko je questions search kare chhe e j best blog topics chhe. list ma volume ane kd % jovo. pick rule: kd 0-15 (easy) ane volume 100+ hoy to perfect first blog. real run - 19 nov 2026, us database, seed "diamond blade" (11,487 keywords madadthi questions view): question keyword | volume | kd % how to dress a diamond blade | 260 | 2 can a diamond blade cut metal | 210 | 3 how to sharpen a diamond blade | 210 | 13 what is a diamond blade | 210 | 8 what are diamond blades | 210 | 24 pick: "how to dress a diamond blade" - kd 2 (easiest) ane volume 260. low kd pehla, high kd pachhi. 3.4.c step 2 - keyword overview thi topic validate karo tool path: seo → keyword research → keyword overview picked keyword enter karo, country select karo. 3 things check karo: volume (260 chhe), kd % (2% = "very easy"), intent (informational = blog mate perfect; transactional hoy to e product/category page mate chhe, blog mate nahi). nichhe serp analysis section ma "update metrics" click karo - 2-5 min lage, wait karo. serp jovo: top 10 ma blog articles chhe ke forums/videos? real run - "how to dress a diamond blade" serp: fakt 189 results. #1 defusco.com no blog (page as 4), pachhi forum thread, facebook post, reddit thread, video page ane tiletools.com no blog. weak serp = navu blog easily rank kari shake. rule: top 10 ma forums, reddit, facebook ke videos hoy = content gap, green signal. badha strong blogs hoy ane kd high hoy = pacho keyword magic tool ma jai ne bijo topic pick karo. 3.4.d step 3 - topic finder thi next blogs nu cluster banao tool path: content → topic finder seed keyword enter karo (diamond blade), audience location select karo (united states). "find topics" click karo - topics collect thava ma 5 min sudhi lai shake. "low-hanging fruit" label vala topics pehla pick karo - low kd + high volume. real run - 19 nov 2026, us: topic | type | keywords | total volume | avg kd concrete saw blades | low-hanging fruit | 22 | 5.4k | 8% tile blade for grinder | low-hanging fruit | 19 | 4.6k | 8% balanced growth topics: grinder blade, tile saw blade, diamond blade, 14 diamond blade, diamond saw blades, concrete blade for grinder har topic niche ready title ideas made chhe (example: "choosing the right concrete saw blade", "how to use a grinder for tiles"). aa topics content calendar (3.5) ma add karo - ek topic = ek blog. 3.4.e step 4 - competitor blog analysis + blog spec nakki karo serp na top 2-3 blog articles kholo ane darek nu word count check karo (page select all kari ne wordcounter.net ma paste karo). darek blog ma su cover karyu chhe te note karo - headings, steps, images, faq. real run - "how to dress a diamond blade" serp na competitor blogs: competitor blog | word count defusco.com - diamond blade sharpening (#1) | ~1,800 toolsliving.com - how to sharpen a diamond blade | ~1,300 tiletools.com - blade maintenance blog | ~900 rules: length rule: tamaro blog top competitor ne match ke beat karvo joiye - content ma, fakt words ma nahi. example: #1 competitor 1,800 words chhe to target 1,500-2,000 words + tena thi vadhare useful points. image spec (fixed): 1 banner image (featured image, blog title sathe) + 3 photos content ni andar (steps, products, real examples). real photos vapro - stock photos ochha ma ochha. headings competitor karta vadhare clear ane step-by-step rakho. 3.4.f step 5 - blog lakho (content writing) structure: h1 = blog title j (primary keyword sathe). intro ma pehla 100 words ma direct answer + primary keyword. headings: competitor analysis mathi malya topics h2/h3 ma, step-by-step order ma. simple words, short paragraphs (2-4 lines), jya possible tya bullet lists - mobile par vanchva easy. primary keyword: title ma, first paragraph ma ane 1-2 headings ma. secondary keywords naturally body ma - stuffing nahi. 3-5 internal links (related category / products / blogs). blog → category page link jaruri (sales flow). spec pramane 1 banner image + 3 photos place karo, darek nu alt text sathe. word count ranking factor nathi - topic fully cover karo, competitor thi vadhare useful banao (navu data, examples, experience). 3.4.g step 6 - e-e-a-t pramane content lakho e-e-a-t = experience, expertise, authoritativeness, trustworthiness. google na quality rater guidelines no concept chhe - direct ranking factor nathi, pan google helpful ane trustworthy content ne reward kare chhe. experience: writer e potee aa vastu kari chhe e batave - potana photos, "ame aa try karyu" examples, real results. example: blade dress karta ni real photo, bookish definition nahi. expertise: writer topic samjto hoy - accurate info, technical terms correct (dressing vs sharpening nu difference jevu), author nu naam + short bio. authoritativeness: brand ane author ni reputation - author page, bija sites/mentions, consistent brand info badhe. trustworthiness: facts sachi ane jya claim hoy tya source cite karelo, real contact details site par, koi fake claim ke fake review nahi. blog ma practical checklist: author name + published/updated date dekhay, real photos, facts sathe source links, potanu experience ke data add karel. 3.4.h step 7 - quality testing (publish pehla) search intent match: keyword je question puchhe chhe, page e j answer aape chhe - koi clickbait mismatch nahi. original wording: competitor ke ai text copy ke near-copy nahi. facts sachi, source link sathe. primary keyword title, h1, slug ane first paragraph ma chhe; ek j h1, h2/h3 proper order ma. badha internal links kholi ne test karya (3-5, working). images: alt text sathe, webp/compressed, mobile ma fast load thay. real phone par akho blog vanchi ne juvo - paragraphs, images, spacing, buttons. ek var full read-through: grammar, spelling, flow. 3.4.i step 8 - meta title ane description (seo rules) title: primary keyword pehla (beginning ma), 50-60 characters, har blog unique. formula: primary keyword - faydo/modifier | brand. description: 150-160 characters, primary keyword + faydo + cta. unique per blog, copy-paste nahi. direct ranking factor nathi - pan saru description ctr (clicks) vadhare chhe. real example (aa j topic par): title: "how to dress a diamond blade: 5-min fix | skyline stone". description: "blade slow ke glazed cut kare chhe? dressing stone ane wet saw tricks thi diamond blade ne 5 minutes ma sharp karo - step-by-step guide." 3.4.j step 9 (last) - publish + google search console ma request indexing blog publish karo - correct category ma, banner image + 3 photos sathe. publish thayu etle live url copy karo. google search console kholo → upar url inspection bar ma live url paste karo → enter. "request indexing" click karo - 1-2 min ma confirm thay. aa step kyarey skip na karo - indexing request vagar navo blog google ma weeks sudhi na dekhay. 3.4.k publishing frequency navi site: week ma 2-4 blogs consistent (quality over quantity). juna blogs dar 6 mahine review karo - outdated hoy ke traffic ghatyu hoy to refresh (ranking ni guarantee nahi). 3.4.l checklist blog topic category/products sathe linked chhe. keyword magic tool ma questions filter thi topic pick karyo

3.6 semrush keyword to content sop — seo sop express home station → journey → dabbo 03 🧭 → 3.6 🧭 3.6 — semrush keyword to content sop dabbo 03 · strategy · ✅ done ☑️ mark done 📍 set current stop version 1.1 | nov 2026 | blog, category, collection, service — badha page type mate aa sop no goal: koi pan team member (fresher hoy to pan) ek seed keyword thi sharu kari ne — keyword research, clustering, mapping, serp analysis, content brief, internal linking ane measurement — same proper process thi kari sake. pehla 3 imandar vaat (vanchya vagar sop use na karvi) 1. koi pan sop 'super rank guaranteed' nathi aapti. ranking ma content quality, site authority (backlinks), technical health, intent match ane competition — badhu kaam kare chhe. aa sop tamaru chance khub vadhare chhe, guarantee nahi. 2. original notes ma "competitor no content 90% same rakho, slug 10% change karo" lakhyu hatu — aa step sop mathi kaadhi nakhyu chhe. google na spam policies ma 'scraped content' ane 'scaled content abuse' clearly che: biji site no content thoda badlav sathe republish karvo, ke 2-3 sites nu content jodi ne kai navu add na karvu = spam. teni jagya e 'serp study → better page banavo' step mukyu chhe (step 6). [confirmed — google search central spam policies] 3. kd% ane volume semrush na estimate chhe, google na number nahi. decision mate useful chhe, pan gsc no real data aave pachhi ene j priority aapvi. 3.6.a 0. short terms (pehli vaar mate) term saral matlab seed keyword sharuaat no broad keyword. example: meal planner template search intent user shu karva maange chhe — janvu (informational), compare karvu (commercial), kharidvu (transactional), koi site par javu (navigational) kd % semrush no estimate ke top 10 ma aavvu ketlu agharu chhe (0-100) pillar page topic no main, broad page. badha cluster pages ene link kare cluster page pillar na ek sub-topic par focused page. pillar ne link kare keyword mapping kayo keyword kaya ek url par target thase — tenu fix list cannibalization tamara 2 page same keyword/intent mate compete kare — beu weak thai jay serp google nu result page (top 10 links, paa, images, ai overview vagere) information gain tamara page ma evu kaik je top results ma nathi — original example, data, template, experience cpc advertiser ek click mate ketla pay kare — vadhu cpc = keyword ma vadhu commercial value (buyer intent no signal) 3.6.b 1. puro process ek nazar ma step shu karvu tool output 1 country + goal + page type + seasonality nakki karo google trends project brief 2 seed keyword research (existing site hoy to gsc pehla) gsc + keyword overview + keyword magic tool raw keyword list 3 clean + filter + priority nakki karo sheet shortlist 4 topic / pillar / cluster banavo keyword strategy builder topic map 5 keyword mapping + existing page check sheet + gsc + site: search 1 keyword group = 1 url 6 serp analysis (copy nahi, study) google + top 10 urls serp analysis sheet 7 content brief brief template writer mate taiyar brief 8 content lakho + on-page checklist docs/cms publish mate taiyar page 9 internal linking sheet / screaming frog link map 10 existing site ni opportunities strategy builder (domain) update list 11 keyword gap + competitor pages keyword gap + organic research gap list 12 measure + refresh karo gsc + ga4 mahina ni decision 3.6.c step 1 — project ni taiyari (10 min) keyword shodhta pehla aa vaat sheet ma lakhi do. aa vagar keyword research disha vagar nu thay. target country: client kya vechhe chhe? (us / uk / india). semrush ma database aaj country no select karvo — global volume par decision na levo. business goal: sale joie chhe (product/category) ke traffic + trust (blog)? site type: shopify ecommerce / service / local / blog. existing pages: site par pehla thi kaya pages chhe — sitemap ke shopify admin mathi list kaadho. (step 5 ma cannibalization check mate joie.) [v1.1 navu] seasonality: google trends ma seed keyword nu 5-year trend (target country) juo. keyword seasonal hoy (christmas gifts, back to school, diwali) to page season thi 2-3 mahina pehla publish karo — semrush nu volume 12 mahina nu average chhe, peak mahina ma demand ghanu vadhare hoi shake. [confirmed — semrush volume = monthly average] 3.6.d step 2 — seed keyword research [v1.1 navu] 2a. existing site hoy to pehla gsc (free ane sauthi accurate) gsc → performance → search results → last 3 months → queries tab. filter: position 8 thi 30 + impressions vadhare. aa keywords par google tamari site ne already relevant maane chhe — sauthi jaldi result aa j aape. query par click → pages tab: kayo page rank thay chhe te note karo (step 5 ma update decision mate). aa list 'gsc opportunities' tab ma muko. semrush data sathe match karo — gsc real chhe, semrush estimate. 2b. keyword overview (semrush) semrush → keyword overview → seed keyword nakho (example: meal planner template) → database = target country (example: us). jovu: volume (target country nu), kd%, intent, cpc, serp features (images, paa, ai overview, shopping). niche 'questions' list joi lo — aa faq / h2 ideas mate kaam aavse. export kari lo. 2c. keyword magic tool (keyword ideas) 'keyword ideas' → view all → keyword magic tool khulse. database = target country. broad match tab rakho (sauthi vadhare ideas). example result: 748 keywords, total volume 18,720, average kd 26%. filters lagavo: volume ≥ 50 (niche ma 20 pan chale), kd% ≤ tamari site ni capacity (navi/low authority site mate 0-30 thi sharu karo), language = english. left side na groups (example: printable, free, weekly, family, google sheets) joi lo — aa j pachhi cluster ideas bane chhe. export → sheet ma 'raw keywords' tab ma paste karo. senior tip kd ni limit fix number nathi. strong da/backlinks vali site 40-50 kd par pan rank kari shake; navi site mate 0-25 thi start karvu safe chhe. pehla tamari site kaya kd na keywords par already page 1 par chhe e gsc + semrush organic research ma juo — e tamari 'safe kd range' chhe. [v1.1 navu] semrush na hoy to — free alternatives • google search console: existing site mate sauthi saro source (real queries). • google keyword planner: volume ranges (exact number ad spend vagar nathi male), country select thay. • google autocomplete, people also ask, related searches: long-tail ane question keywords. • google trends: seasonality ane rising topics. • kd nu manual check: top 10 ma kon chhe juo — moti brands/marketplaces j hoy to agharu; forums, nana blogs, juna pages hoy to chance chhe. process same rahe — fakt data sources badlay. 3.6.e step 3 — clean + priority (sauthi important filter) original notes ma 'highest volume + lowest kd' lakhyu hatu — e sachu chhe, pan adhuru. aa filter lagavo: check shu jovu example relevance business ne kaam nu chhe? je vechta nathi teno keyword kaadho meal planner app na hoy to 'meal planner app download' kaadho intent keyword nu intent tamara page type sathe match thay chhe? 'buy meal planner notebook' = product/collection; 'how to meal plan' = blog business value aa traffic sale/lead aape? (cpc pan signal chhe — vadhu cpc = advertisers ne aa traffic thi kamai) 'free meal planner template' traffic aape, sale ochhu; 'meal planner notebook' sale nu volume target country volume us: 2,400 kd % tamari safe range ma? 26% → ok simple priority score (sheet ma column banavo): priority = business value (1-3) × intent match (1-3) × opportunity (1-3, volume vadhu + kd ochhu = 3) score 18-27 = pehla banavo, 8-17 = pachhi, 1-7 = skip. aa formula andha thai ne na vaparvu — client e koi product push karvu hoy to te upar aave. [v1.1 navu] gsc ma position 8-30 vala keywords ne +1 opportunity aapo — tya page already chhe. 3.6.f step 4 — keyword strategy builder: topic, pillar, cluster semrush → keyword strategy builder → seed keyword(s) nakho → country select → 2-3 min ma serp analyze thase. all pages / topics tab: dar topic ma ek pillar page + ena cluster pages dekhase. example: topic: printable meal planner templates — total volume 97,590, avg kd 32.52%. dar topic nu naam + volume + kd shee
